identificationModule.briefTitle: Evaluating Preventive Therapy With Oint Threolone, Synthomycine or Aqua Cream, for EGFR'I Induced Acneiform Rash
identificationModule.officialTitle: Double Blind Placebo Controlled Trial, for Evaluating Preventive Therapy With Either Oint Threolone Versus Synthomycine Versus Aqua Cream, for EGFR'I Induced Acneiform Rash

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The investigators hypothesized that topical anti-inflammatory treatment could counteract the inflammatory reaction induced by EGFR'Is.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The investigators hypothesized that topical anti-inflammatory treatment could counteract the inflammatory reaction induced by EGFR'Is.

keywords: eruption secondary to treatment with either cetuximab

armGroups.label: ointment Threolone
armGroups.description: Treatment with topical application of combined anti inflammatory and anti bacterial agent.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients developing grade 2 / above rash under preventative treatment with ointment threolone, compared to the other 2 treatment arms.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients developing a rash under preventative treatment with ointment threolone, compared to the other 2 treatment arms

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are planed to initiate treatment with either cetuximab , erlotinib, gefitinib or panitumumab.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who received any facial topical treatment / systemic antibiotics or any anti-inflammatory drug during the 2 weeks prior to study initiation.
* Known hypersensitivity to ointment Synthomycine or to Threolone.
* Patients presented with cutaneous rash during the 2 weeks prior to study initiation

locations.facility: Davidoff Center, Rabin Medical Center, Beilinson
